bridge.sentence: Jul 2026: Profit +€49k but cash +€80k — customers owed €5k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €227k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €129k paid to tax authority; €82k paid for stock or other timing items.

Aug 2026: Profit +€46k but cash +€129k — customers owed €37k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €7k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €78k paid to tax authority; €172k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Sep 2026: Profit +€27k but cash €89k — customers owed €334k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €62k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €115k paid to tax authority; quarterly tax advance of €40k paid; €291k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Oct 2026 (forecast): Profit +€44k but cash +€191k — customers owed €105k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €194k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €81k paid to tax authority; €119k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Nov 2026 (forecast): Profit +€58k but cash €292k — customers reduced their outstanding balance by €143k, collecting more than was invoiced; €492k more paid to suppliers than newly invoiced; VAT of €98k paid to tax authority; €75k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Dec 2026 (forecast): Profit €51k but cash +€250k — customers owed €265k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €243k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €122k paid to tax authority; quarterly tax advance of €40k paid; €464k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).
